title: La ventana no se muestra delante

judgment.rationale: The report describes a regression on 0.99.1 and already includes a diagnostic ZIP. The pinned current source explicitly shows and activates the initial window, so a current version and foreground-window observation are needed before proposing another activation change.
evidence: The report says the resize dialog falls behind other windows after invoking Image Resizer from Explorer.
A PowerToys diagnostic ZIP is already attached.
Current MainWindow.ShowWindow calls Show and Activate after centering on first show.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the behind-window behavior persists on a current release and identify the foreground window at that moment.

fix_assessment.rationale: The pinned source already explicitly activates the first-show window. A new code fix is not grounded until the reporter confirms that the 0.99.1 regression persists on current code.

issue_context.summary: An Image Resizer dialog launched from Explorer was reported to appear behind other windows on PowerToys 0.99.1.
known_information: The issue includes a PowerToys diagnostic ZIP.
The report says the prior version did not show this behavior.
Current MainWindow.ShowWindow centers, shows, and activates the first window.
inferences: The bug may have changed since 0.99.1; the current source activation call is not release evidence.
If the issue persists, the foreground activation policy or launch timing may still differ from the first-show path.
issue_context.analysis: Avoid proposing a duplicate Activate call. First confirm current behavior and record which window retains foreground; no further generic diagnostics are needed because the report already includes a ZIP.
initial_investigation: Read the Spanish issue body and attached diagnostic ZIP reference; no comments or linked fixes are present.
Read src/modules/imageresizer/ui/ImageResizerXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cs: ShowWindow calls CenterOnScreen, Show, and Activate on first display.

information_gaps.information: Whether the dialog still remains behind other windows on a current PowerToys release, and which window is foreground immediately after selecting Image Resizer.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is from 0.99.1, while the pinned source explicitly shows and activates the window on first display. A current repro will distinguish a lingering regression from behavior already addressed in current source or Windows foreground activation policy.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retry from Explorer on the current release, report the exact PowerToys version and the foreground window name after choosing Image Resizer, and say whether clicking the taskbar entry brings the dialog forward.

actions.label: Check whether the current dialog still loses foreground

comment.body: Thanks for including the attachment and noting that this is a regression. The current source already shows and activates the first Image Resizer window, so please retry the current release and share its exact version. Immediately after choosing Image Resizer from Explorer, which window is in the foreground, and does selecting Image Resizer from the taskbar bring the dialog forward? This will show whether the 0.99.1 issue remains despite the current activation path.
